title: Optimum parameter prediction for FPY
summary: Stacked ensemble (CNN + LSTM base learners, XGBoost meta-regressor) that predicts ideal production settings, deployed into a live manufacturing line.

title: White blood cell classification with ViT
summary: Benchmark study of Vision Transformers across multiple public WBC datasets. Published at IEEE INDISCON 2025.

title: Myntra e-commerce flow automation
summary: End-to-end Playwright suite for search, dynamic color filters, cart and quantity changes, handling multi-tab navigation and async modals.

title: Rediff Mail registration automation
summary: Full registration flow automation with form validation, dropdown count checks and a GitHub Actions CI pipeline.

title: Application logging and alerting system
summary: Internal tool on Microsoft Power Platform that monitors log tables and sends real-time email alerts the moment an app misbehaves.

title: Lost & Found Item Tracker
summary: Web app for reporting and tracking lost and found items, with a searchable MongoDB store and a simple Streamlit interface that helps reunite belongings with their owners.
